_about: Everything a maintainer edits for a routine schedule update. seasons: one entry per OCCT schedule period (effective_from comes from OCCT's semester bulletin). pages: route page slug -> display name and shape ('scroll' = the page's stop list is the running order; 'timepoints' = only the timetable columns are reliable). stop_aliases: normalized spelling -> canonical stop name, so one curb has one id. timepoint_aliases: lowercased timetable column header -> canonical stop name, only where the header does not normalize to a stop on the line. seasonal_lines: lines that only run in summer / interim weeks (the service calendar decides when). page_stop_renames: page slug -> {name on that page: distinct canonical name} for stops that share a name with a different physical stop on another line.
